title: TypeScript and Node.js for REST APIs
goal: Build a REST API portfolio project and gain the skills needed for a backend developer role.

phases.title: Setup Development Environment
phases.goal: Install and configure necessary tools and editors.

phases.title: Learn TypeScript Basics
phases.goal: Understand TypeScript syntax and type system.

phases.title: Build a Simple REST API
phases.goal: Create a basic REST API using Node.js and Express.

phases.title: Implement API Testing
phases.goal: Add unit and integration tests to your API.

phases.title: Refactor and Optimize
phases.goal: Refactor the API and optimize for performance.

phases.title: Portfolio and Job Prep
phases.goal: Prepare your portfolio and practice job interview formats.

tasks.title: Install Node.js and VS Code
tasks.doneWhen: Node.js and VS Code are installed and configured.
tasks.check: Running a simple Node.js script in VS Code.

tasks.title: Set Up a New Node.js Project
tasks.why: Create a project structure for the REST API.
steps: Create a new Node.js project folder
Initialize a Node.js project with npm
tasks.doneWhen: A basic project structure with Express is set up.
tasks.check: Running the project in VS Code.

tasks.title: Understand TypeScript
tasks.why: Learn TypeScript syntax and type definitions.
steps: Try basic TypeScript syntax in VS Code
tasks.doneWhen: Familiar with TypeScript syntax and type definitions.
tasks.check: Writing and compiling a simple TypeScript script.

tasks.title: Implement a TypeScript Type
tasks.why: Apply TypeScript types to API requests and responses.
steps: Define a type for API request body
Use the type in a route handler
tasks.doneWhen: A route handler using TypeScript types is implemented.
tasks.check: Running the route handler with and without correct input.

tasks.title: Build a REST API
tasks.why: Create a REST API with multiple endpoints.
tasks.doneWhen: A REST API with multiple CRUD endpoints is built.
tasks.check: Running the API and testing endpoints with Postman.

tasks.title: Test the API
tasks.why: Add unit and integration tests to ensure API reliability.
steps: Install a testing framework like Mocha
Write unit tests for API routes
Write integration tests for API functionality
tasks.doneWhen: The API has comprehensive unit and integration tests.

tasks.title: Optimize and Refactor
tasks.why: Improve the API's performance and maintainability.
steps: Refactor API routes for better structure
tasks.doneWhen: The API is optimized and refactored for better performance and maintainability.
tasks.check: Measuring performance improvements and verifying refactored code.

tasks.title: Prepare Portfolio and CV
tasks.why: Prepare a professional portfolio and CV.
steps: Document the project in a README
Add a link to the portfolio on the CV
tasks.doneWhen: A professional README and CV are created.
tasks.check: A portfolio project README and a professional CV are ready.

tasks.title: Practice Live Coding
tasks.doneWhen: A set of practice live coding sessions are completed.
tasks.check: A recording of a live coding session.

tasks.title: Practice System Design
tasks.doneWhen: A set of practice system design questions is completed.

tasks.title: Practice Take-Home Interviews
tasks.doneWhen: A set of practice take-home coding challenges is completed.

tasks.title: Apply for Jobs
steps: Search for job listings on job boards
tasks.check: A list of applied job positions.
